outcome.descriptive: Sign-off now runs the project's lint probe over the phase's changed files - that lint's rows in both directions, none (said so) when no lint file changed - and stops naming any row a mutation survived or any tree change the probe left behind.

testsAdded: prove-gates.py ch1: changed_rows keeps exactly the rows of a changed lint file (a ./ spelling included), none for an empty set
prove-gates.py ch2: --changed <lint file> proves its red rows then its allow rows, no row of another file
prove-gates.py ch3: an empty or lint-free set runs no row, holds no marker, exits 0 and prints ran none
prove-gates.py ch4: a surviving mutation exits 1 with one ROW NOT PROVEN line per row of that lint naming direction and lint
test_drive_phase lp1: a phase touching the lint file runs the probe once with --changed <that file>, no direction flag, and signs off saying lint probe green
test_drive_phase lp2: a phase touching no lint file signs off and the did-line says ran none
test_drive_phase lp3: a surviving row stops before the sign-off verb quoting ROW NOT PROVEN, nothing signed
test_drive_phase lp4: a probe leaving the checkout changed stops naming the entry even on exit 0
test_drive_phase lp5: over-fire twin - no probe in the project signs off unchanged with no probe clause
test_drive_phase lp6: a green probe held at this HEAD is not run again; at another HEAD it runs once
